metadata.normalized_value: less than $300 per fine-tuning
metadata.evidence: 1). Finance is highly dynamic. [BloombergGPT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.17564) trained an LLM using a mixture of finance data and general-purpose data, which took about 53 days, at a cost of around **$3M**). It is costly to retrain an LLM model like BloombergGPT every month or every week, thus lightweight adaptation is highly favorable. FinGPT can be fine-tuned swiftly to incorporate new data (the cost falls significantly, less than **$300 per fine-tuning**).
metadata.reason: States the project's claimed cost for a fine-tuning run.
